statement: We would rather specify less and specify better. Since 2021 every Fabluxora Interiors project has run on FSC-certified ply, low-VOC finishes and a site waste plan that is measured, not promised.
points: 94% of site timber waste diverted from landfill in 2025
Low-VOC paints and adhesives as standard specification
Warehouse and two showrooms running on rooftop solar

initiatives.title: Certified timber, traced to the mill
initiatives.description: Every sheet of ply and every solid board entering the Bhiwandi workshop carries a chain-of-custody code. Anything that cannot be traced is returned to the supplier.

initiatives.title: Rooftop solar across owned sites
initiatives.description: A 340 kWp array covers the warehouse and two flagship showrooms. Surplus generation is exported back to the state grid on weekends.

initiatives.title: Segregated site waste plan
initiatives.description: Offcuts are sorted at source into timber, board, metal and packaging. Timber goes back to the workshop for jigs, crates and CSR furniture builds.

initiatives.title: Low-VOC finishes as standard
initiatives.description: Water-based lacquers and low-emission adhesives are the default line item, not an upgrade. Clients move in without a two-week airing period.

initiatives.title: Consolidated delivery runs
initiatives.description: Installation loads for projects within a corridor are batched into single runs, cutting empty-van kilometres between Mumbai, Pune and Nashik.

initiatives.title: Appliance take-back at handover
initiatives.description: Fabluxe Home Solutions collects the appliance being replaced at every installation and routes it to a registered e-waste recycler.

commitments: Publish measured site waste figures every year, including the projects that missed target.
Keep FSC-certified ply and low-VOC finishes as the default specification, never a paid upgrade.
Reach net-zero grid electricity across owned warehouses and showrooms by 2030.
Route 100% of collected appliances to registered e-waste handlers, with certificates on file.
Audit our five largest suppliers on labour and material provenance every eighteen months.
